title: Jay Tilak Pentapati: Geographic Data Science & Engineering Portfolio
description:
Source of a Quarto website with eleven reproducible geographic data science projects in Python and R (spatial analysis, spatial econometrics, spatio-temporal modelling, machine learning and big-data processing). Each project ships a pinned environment specification and a data availability note; computational results are frozen in _freeze/. Raw datasets are not included (see data/README.md).

Website: https://tilak-pentapati.github.io
